data.process_heading: How it works, and how long it takes
data.process_sub: Four steps. Most sites take six to ten weeks from kickoff to launch; bigger ones with custom photography or several collections run twelve to sixteen.

process_steps.title: Conversation
process_steps.body: We meet for an hour, in person or on video, and talk through what you need. By the end we both sign off on a one-page brief.

process_steps.title: Strategy
process_steps.body: I write the audience map, the page architecture, and the conversion path. You read it, push back, we revise. The strategy doc is the source of truth for every design choice that follows.

process_steps.title: Design and build
process_steps.body: You see the site as it is built. A preview link arrives at every milestone, so nothing is a surprise on launch day.

process_steps.title: Launch and follow-through
process_steps.body: We go live together, then I stay close for the first month to fix anything that surfaces. After that you own the site outright, with documentation and a simple way to reach me when something comes up.

data.process_cta_title: Let's build a site you won't have to redo.
data.process_cta_sub: Tell me what you are working on. A sentence or two is enough to start. I read every message myself.
